messages.subject: For Agostino Scornajenchi | Energy infrastructure, government relations and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Snam Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Agostino Scornajenchi, Chief Executive Officer.

Snam's role across European energy infrastructure, storage and LNG places government relations, regulation, energy security and stakeholder confidence at the center of long-term execution. Those priorities align closely with my current mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I also support stakeholder governance around a large industrial renewable-energy platform and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, energy-infrastructure stakeholder strategy and sustainability experience might support Snam's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Snam.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
